hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$0"; fi; if grep -qiE "no-?verify|hookspath"; then echo "reef-guard (no python3, degraded): possible gate bypass — denied" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reef-guard.py"
sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "$0"; echo "reef-guard: python3 is required to check a dispatch — denied" >&2; exit 2' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reef-guard.py"
